import re, glob

with open('/inputs/README.md', 'rb') as f:
    original = f.read()

files = sorted(glob.glob('/inputs/*-*.md'))
rows = []
for f in files:
    name = f.split('/')[-1]
    with open(f, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    m = re.search(r'^# (.+)$', content, re.MULTILINE)
    title = m.group(1).strip()
    rows.append(f"| [{name}](../inputs/{name}) | .md | {title} |")

table_lines = [
    "| File | Type | Description |",
    "| --- | --- | --- |",
] + rows

appendix = "\n## Reference index\n\n" + "\n".join(table_lines) + "\n"

full = original.decode('utf-8') + appendix

with open('/work/README.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(full)

print(repr(full[-800:]))
